purpose: Logical manifest; not an existing PMS import schema or runnable DB script

clock.note: Freeze test clock for due/overdue assertions or use separate relative fixtures; never rewrite PDF dates

source.precision: weekly; green submission markers not completion evidence

project.title: ITA — Internal Process Safety (QA seed)
project.source: PDF weekly header; budget and owner synthetic

permissions_note: Check effective inherited access, keep LAB-G in restricted space with no broader inherited share; assign external reviewer only to explicitly shared item; outsider has no shares. Map principal IDs to actual IDs.

guards.negative: omit reviewer or pending required child; reject atomically

dependency_tests: Use isolated clones to exercise SS/FF/SF, negative lag, holiday, cycles; no dependencies inferred into PDF baseline. Capture original dates then compare engine output.

financial_oracle.note: PRD current calculation billable only. Report all-hours cost as parity gap, not failed PRD unless amended. Set rates chronologically using supported fixtures/service; verify snapshot after rate update.

external_test_configuration.github: disposable private test repo + issue ID supplied via env
external_test_configuration.google_calendar: disposable test calendar ID + OAuth provided via env
external_test_configuration.storage: test bucket and test Pydio workspace; no prod
external_test_configuration.identity: isolated OIDC/SAML/SCIM test IdP; fixtures and live split
external_test_configuration.webhook: local test receiver; signature verification; never send to production
external_test_configuration.secret_policy: do not store passwords, OAuth token, TOTP secrets or API keys in fixture or evidence

optional_load_profile.note: isolated generated dataset, not PDF; benchmark with fixed commit/data and concurrency

reset_policy: Target disposable test database or dedicated instance only; two passes idempotent; cleanup by tracked QA namespace, never truncate existing DB; keep source immutable; apply mutating tests on sandbox clones.
fixture_creation_order_note: Status histories, approvals, automation outcomes, version history, time entries and provider sync must be produced through actual actions. Fixture lists are test input recipes, not pre-populated PASS evidence.
